name: sector-mobile
description: SECTOR for Android and iOS: a native shell that connects to a SECTOR server (your PC's, a friend's or a hosted one).

scripts.android: node prepare.js && npx cap add android && npx capacitor-assets generate --android && node native/patch-android.js && npx cap sync android
scripts.ios: node prepare.js && npx cap add ios && npx capacitor-assets generate --ios && node native/patch-ios.js && npx cap sync ios
